ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation via Masqueraded XML File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a scheduled task using the "-XML" flag with a file without the '.xml' extension. This behavior could be indicative of potential defense evasion attempt during persistence

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/create.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-create.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/xml.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-xml.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xml.*") OR (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Installer\\\\MSI.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\,zzzzInvokeManagedCustomActionOutOfProc.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\OEM\\\\UpgradeTool\\\\CareCenter\\_*\\\\BUnzip\\\\Setup\\_msi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Axis\\ Communications\\\\AXIS\\ Camera\\ Station\\\\SetupActions\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Axis\\ Communications\\\\AXIS\\ Device\\ Manager\\\\AdmSetupActions\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Zemana\\\\AntiMalware\\\\AntiMalware\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Dell\\\\SupportAssist\\\\pcdrcui\\\.exe$")))
